query: I am a self-employed person. Can I contribute to my MediSave together with my employees' CPF using the CPF Payment Form (CPF 91)?
reference_answer: You’re required to make your MediSave payable separately from your employees' CPF. This is because payments made using the CPF Payment Form (CPF 91) will be credited as employer contributions and will not be recognized as self-employed payments.If you would like to make CPF contributions as a self-employed person, there arevarious waysto do so.
answer: As per the lack of provided evidence, you cannot use the CPF Payment Form (CPF 91) to contribute to your MediSave and your employees' CPF accounts together. [Document N]
